Key: frames = trust/deployment zones; box = runtime actor/process; cylinder = stored state. Arrows: caller → recipient,
response included; dotted = local command/I/O; dashed = async. Flow type is also written on each arrow.
Acked is not saved

Acks mean daemon memory only;
canvas.json is rewritten 800ms after
the last op or on SIGINT/SIGTERM, so a
crash can lose acked edits.
Unparseable JSON stops startup; bad
shapes are skipped.
Source: src/server/canvas.ts
Reconnect replays; reload drops

After a drop it reconnects (500ms–10s
backoff), takes a daemon-memory
snapshot that replaces the page, then
replays unacked ops. Those live only in
page memory: a full reload drops
them.
Source: web/src/canvas/sync.ts
Token gate on reload

LAN WS upgrades need the token; the
?t= link sets a 1-year HttpOnly cookie
that reloads resend, and the token
survives daemon restarts. Without it:
401, page shows offline and retries.
Source: src/server/daemon.ts
Outside this view: Hosted relay (on by default), MCP server, AI mapping, git commits; Marks/chat/graph files, image assets, other browsers' live ops.
